Phase 2, Week 1, Thu
Workout Specific Movement Prep
View Workout Specific Movement Prep
- This is progression 1/4 for our benchmark workout, "Summit"
- Settle into a rhythm you could repeat on test day
- Keep the kettlebell swings unbroken
- The test weight will be 24/16 kg; choose a lighter bell if you need it to keep moving
- Your opening row should take about 3 minutes
A. As Many Rounds and Reps as possible in 12 minutes, with Buy In:
Buy In:
Row 750 meters
Then AMRAP:
12 Kettlebell Swings @ 24/16 kg
15 Box Jumps
Row 250 meters
- ROW DISTANCE
600-750m
200-250m
---- REST 2 MINS BEFORE THE NEXT PART ---
B. As Many Rounds and Reps as possible in 12 minutes, with Buy In:
Buy In:
Row 750 meters
Then AMRAP:
20 Dumbbell Thrusters @ 15/10 kg
15 Box Jumps
Row 250 meters
- ROW DISTANCE
600-750m
200-250m
C. ACCESSORIES
Easy SkiErg for 8 minutes
- Bring your breathing back down
- Long smooth strokes
- Breathe through your nose
3 alternating sets of:
D1. Bird Dog Hold for 20-25 seconds
- Brace before you reach
- Switch sides each set
Rest 20 seconds
D2. 8-10 Band Face Pulls (2011 tempo)
- RIR 3
Rest 20 seconds
D3. 8-10 Prone Y Raises (2011 tempo)
- Thumbs up, shoulders down
Rest 20 seconds
Show less
